basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: LiveMate plays the IPTV playlists you add. It does not store or distribute any streams, playlists or user data.
onDevice: The playlist links and Xtream API details you add

permissions.name: Local network / AirPlay
permissions.why: To cast to your TV, when you choose to.

services.name: Your IPTV provider
services.what: The app connects to the playlist and stream addresses you enter; that provider's own privacy policy applies.

purchases: Premium is sold through the App Store as a subscription. Apple handles payment.
